title: EFC Ontological Foundations v1.0: The Co-Primary Structure
abstract: Establishes the ontological basis for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) by arguing that energy-flow and entropy are co-primary, differentiated aspects of a single pre-geometric potential that separates at the Planck transition. Resolves circularity in monistic ontologies and integrates coherently with EFC’s Core Lock dynamics, EBE epistemic framework, and RCMP measurement protocol, aligning with insights from Wheeler, Verlinde, and Prigogine.
